neet_phy_u05_t05_1.working: Moments of inertia: sphere 2/5 MR², disc 1/2 MR², shell 2/3 MR², ring MR². The ring is largest.

neet_phy_u05_t05_3.working: About the symmetry axis, length does not matter, so I = MR²/2.

neet_phy_u05_t05_4.working: Ring about a diameter is 1/2 MR² (II). Disc is 1/4 (I). Shell is 2/3 (IV). Solid sphere is 2/5 (III).

neet_phy_u05_t05_5.working: A is true. B is true. C is false because 2/5 < 1/2. D is false because a hollow cylinder has MR². E is true because ML²/3 = 4 × ML²/12.
